title: Equality of original-page and decalage-class representative kernels
statement: Let \(C\) be abelian, \(U=(K,F)\) a filtered cochain complex, \(p,q,r\in\mathbb Z\), \(r\ge2\), \(n=p+q\), and \(R_r^{p,n}\) its original cycle representative pullback. Let \(z:R_r^{p,n}\to Z_r^{p,n}(\operatorname{gr}_F K)\) satisfy the defining square with the quotient projection \(F^pK^n\to(F^p/F^{p+1})^n\). If \(\pi_r\) is the boundary-quotient projection [lem-sp-filtered-complex-canonical-model] and \(c_r\) the concrete decalage right-interval class map [def-sp-filtered-complex-decalage-page-data], then \(\ker(z\pi_r)=\ker(c_r)\) as subobjects of \(R_r^{p,n}\).

proof.text: For any quotient interval F^a/F^b and any representative x∈F^p with a≤p≤b, its homology class is zero exactly when its ambient inclusion factors through (F^p∩dF^a)+F^b. Prove this using the quotient exact sequence, opcycles and epimorphic refinements, extending the existing boundary-zero calculation to arbitrary endpoints.

proof.text: For D=Dec(F), the denominator (D^(-q)∩dD^(1-(q+r-1)))+D^(1-q) and the original denominator (F^p∩dF^(p-r+1))+F^(p+1) have the same factorization condition on an r-cycle. In either direction refine the epimorphism onto the sum, separate its two terms, and use the decalage intersection formula and d squared zero to lift them.

proof.text: The cokernel zero criterion, proved by Abelian.monoLift and monicity of the graded-cycle inclusion, identifies the original quotient zero condition with factorization through the graded boundary subobject. The public boundary-pullback theorem converts it to vanishing in the opcycles of F^(p-r+1)/F^(p+1). Apply the general interval boundary-zero calculation from the first step for F and for Dec(F), and the denominator equivalence from the second step. Test the resulting equivalence on the two kernel-subobject inclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem filteredComplexDecalageRepresentative_kernels
    (U : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) (p q r : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r)
    (z : (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r : C) ⟶
      (U.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) r : C))
    (hz : z ≫ (U.filtration.complexCycles p (p + q) r).arrow =
      (U.filtration.complexCycleRepresentatives p (p + q) r).arrow ≫
        (U.filtration.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f (p + q)) :
    kernelSubobject (z ≫ filteredComplexPageπ U.obj U.filtration r (p, q)) =
      kernelSubobject (filteredComplexDecalageRepresentativeClass U p q r hr)
